title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Protocol Using pBIOZOL Method
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4rdgv26
materials: Grind tissue to a powder in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Initial RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1.3 mL of cold (4 °C) pBIOZOL Reagent to up to 100 mg of frozen, ground tissue.

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 00:05:00 at 20 °C, laying the tube horizontally to maximize surface area.

steps.title: Phase Separation Preparation
steps.instruction: Add NaCl and chloroform to the extract to facilitate phase separation.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 5 Molarity (M) NaCl to the extract

steps.title: Separate Phases
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 4 °C for 00:10:00 to separate the phases.

steps.title: Isolate Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the top aqueous phase to an RNase-free tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the top aqueous phase to an RNase-free tube

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using isopropyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropyl alcohol to the aqueous phase

steps.title: Collect RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant to isolate the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Decant the supernatant, taking care not to lose the pellet

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with chilled ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of chilled 75% ethanol to the pellet
Decant the liquid carefully, taking care not to lose the pellet
Briefly centrifuge to collect the residual liquid and remove it with a pipette

steps.title: Dissolve RNA
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the RNA pellet in RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL – 30 µL RNase-free water to dissolve the RNA
Pipette the water up and down over the pellet to dissolve the RNA
Mix by briefly vortexing or flicking the bottom of the tube until the sample is thoroughly suspended

steps.title: Final Clarification
steps.instruction: Ensure the final solution is clear and transferred to a clean tube.

substeps.instruction: If any cloudiness is observed, centrifuge the solution at Room temperature for 00:01:00
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh RNase-free tube
